question.text: Under SEBI Circular dated June 25, 2021, 'key management personnel' of an AIF Manager includes:

answer.text: Only the CEO and CFO, strictly two persons
All employees with more than 5 years of service
Only SEBI-registered investment advisers employed by the Manager
Members of the key investment team disclosed in PPM, employees involved in decision-making (MD, CEO, CIO, WTDs or equivalent), and any other person the AIF/Manager declares as KMP

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.313 (reproducing the SEBI Circular dated June 25, 2021), KMP includes: (a) members of the key investment team disclosed in the PPM, (b) employees involved in decision-making on behalf of the AIF, including senior management at MD/CEO/CIO/WTD or equivalent levels, and (c) any other person declared as KMP by the AIF or Manager. The Trap: A CEO/CFO-only definition is too narrow, and IA-registration or tenure-based definitions are not in the source. Note: The "any other person declared as KMP" clause is part of the source-backed three-part KMP definition.
